meta.title: Pricing — Mobilcab
meta.description: Now: Free plan (Cut list, unlimited exports) + Founding Partner program. At billing: Free with 3 exports + paid Cut list; Atelier, CNC, Production and AI follow later.

hero.label: Pricing
hero.title: Free on Cut list now. 20% Founding Partner when billing opens.
hero.body: Now: the Free plan includes 3D design and cut lists, with no export limits. When subscriptions open, Free gets 3 downloads per account, and the paid Cut list plan keeps unlimited exports. For 20% off paid plans, join the Founding Partner program before billing — we close enrollment then. We announce list amounts at paid launch.

callout.title: New here?
callout.body: Founding Partner: free sign-up now, 20% off list for 6 months from first payment on paid plans that ship in that window. We close enrollment at billing. Anyone who joins later pays list price.

fpYearly: Founding Partner: 20% off list, 6 months from first payment
cancel: No contract — cancel anytime (once subscriptions exist)

more.title: More detail
more.body: How Free differs from Cut list, what comes next (Atelier, CNC, Production, AI), and how Founding Partner works — on the FAQ page.

note: We don't charge until paid plans open. Until then: Free = full Cut list, no export limit. At billing: Free with 3 downloads + paid Cut list. Next, in order: Atelier (nesting, labels, quotes), CNC, Production, AI — shown as coming soon until each ships. Founding Partner enrollment closes at billing; 20% / 6 months is only for people in the program.
